description: Control playback in the Music app and read what it is playing: play, pause, stop, skip to the next or previous track, play a playlist by its exact name, set shuffle or repeat, or get the current state. Every action returns the state Music reports afterward — player state, current track, shuffle, and repeat. play and play_playlist launch Music when it is closed; get_current, pause, and stop leave it closed and report running=false; next, previous, set_shuffle, and set_repeat fail with not_running. track is null when Music has nothing loaded, and also, with track_unavailable saying why, when Music refuses to name a track outside the library (radio or catalog playback on recent macOS). The first call shows macOS's Automation consent dialog for Music; if the call times out while it is open, answer the dialog and retry. macos_check_permissions reports the grant as automation_music. System output level belongs to macos_control_volume.

action.description: play resumes or starts playback; play_playlist plays the named playlist; pause and stop halt it; next and previous skip tracks; set_shuffle and set_repeat change the play order; get_current only reads.

playlist.description: Exact name of the playlist to play, as Music shows it in its sidebar; the first playlist with that name plays. Required for action=play_playlist.

repeat.description: off plays through once, one repeats the current track, all repeats the playlist. Required for action=set_repeat.

shuffle.description: true plays tracks in random order. Required for action=set_shuffle.

name: macos_control_music

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_running`: next, previous, set_shuffle, or set_repeat is called while Music is not running. `playlist_not_found`: play_playlist names a playlist Music does not have. `accessibility_required`: The host app is denied Automation > Music permission. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

player_state.description: The player state Music reports after the action. Null exactly when running is false.

playlist.description: The playlist name as Music reports it. Present for action=play_playlist.

repeat.description: The repeat mode read back from Music. Null exactly when running is false.

running.description: True when Music is running. False only for get_current, pause, and stop on a closed Music, which leave it closed.

shuffle.description: True when shuffle is on, as read back from Music. Null exactly when running is false.

album.description: Album, or null when the track has none.

artist.description: Artist, or null when the track has none.

track.description: The current track. Null when Music is closed, has nothing loaded, or would not return the track (see track_unavailable).

track_unavailable.description: Present when the player is not stopped but Music would not return the current track, saying why.

title: Control macOS Music
